issue.title: [Bug] Library write-failure banner cannot be dismissed or collapsed
issue.body:
## Environment

- magpie: `0.1.1595`
- OS: macOS `26.3` (Apple Silicon)
- Page: Library → Instructions
- Related agent: Grok Build

## Description

When importing or syncing Library content fails while writing an agent's file, magpie shows a write-failure banner at the top of the Library page:

```text
Some of the Library couldn't be written
Grok Build · Instructions
stat [redacted local path]: permission denied
```

![Redacted screenshot of the Library write-failure banner](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c5c4be21-3b7a-4f1a-9041-d7f20b800b22)

The banner only provides a **Try again** button. It has no close, dismiss, or collapse action.

The failure may require the user to resolve a file-permission problem outside magpie, or the user may intentionally keep the current configuration and not retry immediately. In either case, the user cannot acknowledge the error or remove it from the page. The banner continues to occupy space at the top of the Library and interferes with subsequent use.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Install Grok Build and open the Library in magpie.
2. Import or configure Instructions that magpie must write to Grok Build's `AGENTS.md`.
3. Make that file inaccessible or unwritable to magpie so the operation returns `permission denied`.
4. Trigger a Library import or sync.
5. Observe the write-failure banner at the top of the Library page.

## Actual behavior

- magpie displays the “Some of the Library couldn't be written” banner and the specific error.
- The banner only offers **Try again**.
- The user cannot close or collapse the banner after understanding the error or deciding not to retry immediately.

## Expected behavior

- Keep the detailed error and the **Try again** action available.
- Add a separate close or collapse action with an accessible name, such as “Dismiss write error”.
- Dismissing the banner should hide only the current banner. It should not imply that the write succeeded or clear the error state attached to the affected Library item.
- A later sync that produces a new write error should show the banner again.

## Additional context

The screenshot shows the Instructions page with a Grok Build write failure and no control for dismissing the banner. The local file path and username have been redacted.

comments.body:
The banner is drawn by `problemsCard` in `internal/gui/assets/plugins/library/client.js`, and it offered only Try again: nothing on the card could take it off the page, so a write failure the reader has to fix outside magpie (Grok Build's `AGENTS.md` in the report) stayed in the way with no way to acknowledge it.

The branch adds a close button beside Try again, labelled "Dismiss write error". Closing only stops drawing the card: nothing is written, `lib.problems` keeps the error, and the item keeps the amber dot and the reason in its tooltip. An agent's own skill that is in the library's way is not a failed write, so it stays listed. A change that reports problems opens the card again, the same failure repeated included, and the words are in zh, zh-TW, ja and de.

[fix/3745-bug-library-write-failure-banner-cannot-](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3745-bug-library-write-failure-banner-cannot-), commit 1d3b657d3c7216eec282117d83b4ec0743b7121d

What was run: `internal/gui/tests/library-items.test.cjs` fails on the code before the change (`locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded`, waiting for `getByRole('button', { name: 'Dismiss write error' })`) and passes with it in Chromium and WebKit, en and zh (22 passed, 44 with `own-skill.test.cjs`); `go build ./...` and `go vet ./internal/gui/` print nothing; `go test ./internal/gui/` 462 passed. `i18n-keys.test.cjs`'s "a plugin's words are its own" and `internal/agent`'s TestAgyShell are already red on upstream/main, not from this change.

It is a fork branch, ready to review, and not a claim on the issue's ownership: JoeyWu-tech said they would take this one, so treat it as a reference patch.

Withdrawing this one: JoeyWu-tech said "I'll take this one." two days before I posted, and I missed that before opening the branch. The branch `fix/3745-bug-library-write-failure-banner-cannot-` stays as a reference for whoever holds the issue, but it is not a claim on it and I am not pushing further work here.

Patch: https://github.com/JoeyWu-tech/magpie/tree/fix/3745-dismiss-write-error, commit b9d35e53 on origin/main f8cd964a (applies as is on 0f4763f4), `git format-patch --no-signature --full-index --stdout f8cd964a..b9d35e53 | sha256sum` is `66e112e547e3c7d7b0ab49620a99bf17be234b9b2ac127664393fbab41225606`.

Zachary-wW, the card has a × beside Try again now. In your case, Grok Build's AGENTS.md that can't be stat'ed, it hides the card, and the card stays hidden while you keep editing on the Instructions tab, even though each change fails on that file again (the toast after a change still says so). It comes back when something new can't be written, or when that file fails again after it was written in between, and after a reload. I ran it against magpie's own replies from a sandbox where the file can't be stat'ed, in Chromium and WebKit, but I haven't tried it in the real app on macOS.

Ported @yinwu01's patch: `c0dd5838c`, in v0.1.2855. The Library's write-failure card has a × that hides it until a failure that wasn't shown before; the same failures don't bring it back. library-problems-hide passes in Chromium and WebKit; with the other library-* files and i18n-keys, 1044 of 1044 pass. The whole GUI suite runs after the release.

Follow-up: the new library-problems-hide test gave its page a 20s navigation timeout, which the nav-timeout guard (#4470) refuses. Raised to 60s in 6d1e3f1e2 (with panel-open-once, which broke the same guard).

issue.title: Library: an agent's instructions that can't be written have no mark of their own, so a hidden write-failure card leaves no trace

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
With #3745's patch the "Some of the Library couldn't be written" card can be hidden until something new can't be written. A skill that couldn't be given keeps an amber dot on its agent's chip, and servers, hooks, subagents and projects carry their own problems in the view too (SkillView.Problems, ServerView.Problems, the hooks', subagents' and projects' views). An agent's instructions don't: AgentInstructions has no error of its own (internal/library/instructions.go), and neither has an agent's whole MCP file (a problem with what "mcp" and no server). So in the reporter's case, Grok Build's AGENTS.md that magpie can't stat, once the card is hidden nothing on the Instructions tab says that file wasn't written; only each change's toast still names it.

A mark on the agent's row on the Instructions tab, like a chip's dot, with the error as its tooltip, would keep it in sight while the card is hidden. The page could take it from the library's problems (agent and what "instructions") without a change to the API. The same goes for an agent's MCP file on the MCP servers tab.
